positioning_and_value_prop.positioning_statement: Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access Browser is the industry's only SASE solution with a natively integrated secure browser, creating a secure workspace on both managed and unmanaged devices, providing consistent, frictionless Zero Trust access to SaaS and private applications on any device, anywhere.
positioning_and_value_prop.value_prop_headline: Secure Browsers: How to protect your organization with consistent security for any user, device, location, and app
key_benefits: Reducing risk, reducing costs, and increasing productivity
Consistent security for any user, device, location, and app
Comprehensive visibility into and control over web applications and user actions
Frictionless Zero Trust access to SaaS and private applications on any device
Enhanced security for both managed and unmanaged devices
Reduced reliance on VDI infrastructure and lower operational costs
differentiators: Industry's only SASE solution with a natively integrated secure browser
Advanced AI-powered security capabilities to protect against sophisticated phishing attacks and advanced malware
